cur-fossil-bouri.dateNote: In 1997 Yohannes Haile-Selassie found skull pieces on the Bouri peninsula of the Middle Awash, Ethiopia. Named Australopithecus garhi in 1999, it is about 2.5 million years old. Animal bones with cut marks were found nearby.
cur-fossil-bouri.summary: A 2.5-million-year-old human relative from Ethiopia, found near butchered bones.

cur-fossil-dikika.dateNote: On 10 December 2000 Zeresenay Alemseged's team found the skull of a child at Dikika in the Afar of Ethiopia, across the Awash River from Hadar, where Lucy was found. Named Selam, she was about 3 years old. She is about 3.3 million years old (Australopithecus afarensis).
cur-fossil-dikika.summary: The skeleton of a 3-year-old girl of Lucy's kind, 3.3 million years old.
